department: Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science (Doctoral Committee in Computer Science)

deadline.value: The faculty has no application deadlines; decisions take about 1 week to 2 months.

entry_route.value: The typical applicant holds a Master's degree or Diploma in computer science; a non-CS degree may require extra courses in the first two years.
entry_route.quote: The typical applicant holds a Master degree (or Diploma) in Mathematics or Computer Science
